description.short: Retail Wave 1 Cowork plugin: a grounded first response, and a clean escalation
description.full: Retail Wave 1 Cowork plugin: a grounded first response, and a clean escalation packet when it cannot resolve. Classifies intent against the taxonomy (intent_classify); assembles customer, order, loyalty and delivery context and detects contradictions (context_assemble); retrieves the approved answer; drafts the resolution in channel and tone or builds the structured handoff packet. Reliability beats reach: it does not issue goodwill credit, change payment details or grant unsupported policy exceptions.
